name: quarry
description: Search your documents by meaning. Index PDFs, images, spreadsheets, presentations, code, and webpages, then ask Claude about them.
long_description:
Quarry extracts knowledge from your files and makes it searchable by meaning. It reads PDFs (text and scanned), images, spreadsheets, presentations, source code, Markdown, LaTeX, DOCX, HTML, and webpages.

Architecture is daemon-first: a single local `quarryd` process loads the embedding model once and serves search over a versioned REST API. This bundle registers the stdio `quarry mcp` server, a thin client that reaches the daemon; it does not run an in-process engine. Data lives in `~/.punt-labs/quarry`, owned by the daemon.

Prerequisite: install the `quarry` CLI and start the daemon first (`quarry install`), which also downloads the embedding model. Everything runs locally with no cloud accounts or API keys.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Search indexed documents by meaning (hybrid vector + BM25, RRF-fused).

tools.name: ingest
tools.description: Fetch and index an HTTP(S) URL (sitemap discovery with single-page fallback).

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Index inline text content (clipboard, API response, sandbox-uploaded files).

tools.name: learn
tools.description: Save a distilled lesson that gets retrieval preference over ordinary results.

tools.name: list
tools.description: List documents, collections, databases, or directory registrations.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Show a document, collection, or registration in detail.

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete indexed data for a document or collection.

tools.name: register_directory
tools.description: Register a directory for incremental filesystem sync.

tools.name: deregister_directory
tools.description: Remove a directory registration (optionally keeping indexed data).

tools.name: sync_all_registrations
tools.description: Sync all registered directories: ingest new/changed, drop deleted.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Report database status: document/chunk counts, storage size, model info.

tools.name: use
tools.description: Switch to a different named database for subsequent operations.
